summary: Avoid unconditional LLMClient initialization in AutonomousSession and FixOrchestrator when LLM is disabled (#129)

delivery.outcome: FixOS #129 (PLF-038): prevent unconditional LLMClient(config) initialization in AutonomousSession.__init__ and FixOrchestrator.__init__ when use_llm=False or when use_llm=None and native Gemini transport lacks an API key.
nonGoals: No changes to GeminiNativeClient API key validation when LLM is explicitly active
No changes to HITL session LLM requirements

architecture.decision: Skip LLMClient construction when use_llm is False, and catch LLMError during default (use_llm=None) construction so heuristic mode operates without an API key under gemini_transport='native'.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit via protected PR if needed.

validation.evidence: AutonomousSession and FixOrchestrator run in heuristic mode with gemini_transport='native' and empty api_key without raising LLMError.
Governance check and unit tests pass.
